Since its foundation more than 100 years ago, Exyte has built unique expertise in controlled and regulated manufacturing environments. The company operates worldwide and partners with some of the most technologically demanding customers in markets such as semiconductors, batteries, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and data centers. Explore your tasks and responsibilities Conduct Quality Inspections: Perform comprehensive inspections of Civil, Structural, and Architectural works to verify compliance with project specifications, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. Documentation and Reporting : Maintain detailed records of inspection findings, including discrepancies, non-conformities, and corrective actions. Generate comprehensive reports summarizing inspection results and recommendations for improvement. Compliance Assurance : Stay abreast of EU directives, regulations, and standards relevant to CSA systems acc. to the contracted and submitted building permit. Ensure that CSA installation meet the requirements outlined in these directives and standards. Show your expertise Degree Civil Engineering, or completed training CSA, or a related field. Several years of hands-on construction experience, conducting inspections, evaluating compliance, and implementing corrective actions. Proven experience in data-center, high-tech, or comparable complex construction environments. Thorough understanding of requirements and tasks for CSA works Proficiency in interpreting construction drawings, specifications and CSA-related plans Advanced knowledge of EU directives and regulations Very good English language skills, both written and spoken; German language skills are an advantage. Willingness to travel within Germany as required by the project assignments. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to diverse stakeholders. What we offer you Are you looking for challenging projects? We offer you the opportunity to actively contribute to customized, large-scale engineering and construction projects. Do you enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment? Then Exyte is the right place for you. Your start at Exyte: Benefit from a comprehensive onboarding program, on-the-job training, and a wide range of online and classroom-based training courses (e.g., German and English language training) available through our extensive Learning Management System. Buddy System: Several weeks of dedicated support and close collaboration with your colleagues to help you settle into your new role. Keep fit: Exyte subsidizes your fitness membership through EGYM Wellpass, giving you access to over 5,000 locations across Germany. Do you want to actively shape the future? At Exyte, you will find the innovative and continuously growing environment you need to make an impact. So, what are you waiting for? Become part of this exciting journey!
